# Songdance

> Songdance teaches Somatic Vocal Healing — the honest sound of what you feel,
> made out loud until it's been heard. Not singing. Sounding. The work is led
> by Jacob and a small circle of facilitators, online and at retreats.

Somatic Vocal Healing (SVH) is a body-based vocal practice. You make the sound
*of* what is present — a feeling, a body part, an energy — and stay with it
until it has been acknowledged. It begins with a question: *what is here?* — and
lets that answer out, one honest tone at a time. You don't need a good voice,
only an honest one; you cannot do it wrong.

It is not singing, not performance, not chanting, and not a sound bath played
*for* you. In a sound bath you lie down and receive. Here you are the one
sounding — nobody does it to you, because nobody can. A facilitator holds the
space; the person sounding does the healing themselves.

## The four principles (the language we always use)

- The sound **of** something, never the sound *for* it. We give voice to a feeling; we don't have sound performed at us.
- **Acknowledgment**, not "release" or "letting go." Nothing is thrown in a fire. What is met fully tends to surrender its need to keep speaking.
- **Sounding**, not singing. One tone — the tone of what's there, right now. We say *tone* or *sound*, never *note*.
- Facilitators **hold space**; the participant heals themselves. No outcome is promised and no one is rescued.

## Start here

- [Live Vocal Healing Workshop — 9€](https://songdance.co/workshop): One live online hour to meet the practice. No experience needed; you sound along from home.
- [What is Somatic Vocal Healing](https://songdance.co/what-is-svh): The fullest plain-language explanation of the practice, with answers to the most common questions.

## Courses

- [All courses](https://songdance.co/courses): The full catalogue — the practice itself, courses by theme, and guided musical journeys.
- [12-Week Course](https://songdance.co/courses/12-week): Twelve weeks of guided modules and live weekly Q&A to learn the practice for yourself. Also in German: https://songdance.co/courses/12-week-de
- [Practitioner Training](https://songdance.co/courses/certification): A nine-month live certification path — go fully in with your own voice and learn to hold space for another's.
- [Professional Masterclass — 118€](https://songdance.co/courses/masterclass): A 90-minute live masterclass for therapists, coaches, and facilitators — what sound can do when words run out.
- [Grief Course — €99](https://songdance.co/courses/grief): Sounding with grief, the river that wants moving rather than fixing.
- [Forgiveness Course](https://songdance.co/courses/forgiveness): A guided course on the sound of forgiveness.
- [Authentic Singing Journey — €99](https://songdance.co/courses/authentic-singing), [Magical Movement Journey — €49](https://songdance.co/courses/magical-movement), [Inner Child Journey — €29](https://songdance.co/courses/inner-child): Self-paced guided musical journeys.
- [Songdeck](https://songdance.co/courses/songdeck): A deck of cards for a daily sounding practice at home.

## Retreats

- [Ritual of Belonging](https://songdance.co/retreats/ritual-of-belonging): An in-person sounding retreat.
- [Dolphin and Sound](https://songdance.co/retreats/dolphin-and-sound): A retreat sounding with wild dolphins.
- [Klankopstellingen — Drongen, Gent (Nederlands)](https://songdance.co/retreats/klankopstellingen-gent): A Dutch-language sound-constellation retreat near Ghent.
